notes.title: Update Now Available: Lost in Nowhere Version 1.2
notes.notes:
Dear Community,

The wait is over! We are thrilled to announce that Version 1.2 of Lost in Nowhere is now live. This update brings a host of exciting new content and improvements that will elevate your gaming experience to the next level. Here’s a look at the highlights:

New Game Modes:

[list]
[*] Easy Mode: Perfect for players who prefer a less challenging experience. Enjoy the game with additional weapons, more ammunition, and helpful waypoints that guide you safely through the maze.
[*] Wendigo Mode: Embrace the challenge and face the mist and the fearsome Wendigos. Survive encounters with three of these formidable creatures and earn the title of a true Wendigo Hunter.
[*] Doomsday Mode: Test your survival skills! Armed with an arsenal of weapons and ammunition, face unending waves of challenges.
[/list]

We hope you are as excited as we are to dive into these new features. Have fun playing, and thank you for your ongoing support!

Your WASD Software Team

notes.title: Lost in Nowhere - Version 1.2
notes.notes:
Dear Community,

We are excited to present to you today the upcoming update for Lost in Nowhere. Version 1.2 brings exciting new content and improvements that make the gaming experience even more intense. Here's everything you need to know:

[b]New Game Modes:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Easy Mode:[/b] For those who prefer it a bit easier. This mode offers more weapons, more ammunition, and helpful waypoints that guide you through the labyrinth.
[*] [b]Wendigo Mode:[/b] Face the fog and the terrifying Wendigos. Survive an encounter with three of these mighty creatures and you can call yourself a true Wendigo Hunter.
[*] [b]Doomsday Mode:[/b] How long can you survive? Armed with an abundance of weapons and ammunition, fight against continuous waves of challenges.
[/list]

[b]Further Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Minor bug fixes and optimizations improve stability and the gaming experience.
[/list]

[b]A Look to the Future:[/b]
With Lost in Nowhere, we have gained valuable experience in game development, which will benefit our next big project, an ambitious open-world game for Xbox Series S/X, Playstation 5, and PC. We are excited about what lies ahead and thank you for your ongoing support and feedback.

This update is another step in making our game the experience you deserve. Thank you for being part of our journey.

[b]The update will be available by the end of the month![/b]

notes.title: Upcoming version 1.1 & information on the aim of the game
notes.notes:
Hello Community, 
We have received a lot of feedback via various platforms, and we are very grateful for it. 

We are currently working on the next version 1.1, which will not only include language support, but also various bug fixes, performance improvements & general improvements.

[h2]About the goal of the game[/h2]

We have seen from Steam reviews and videos that some players are not clear what the goal of the game is. Therefore, here again very clearly: [b]There are 3 puzzles to solve! [/b]
If you just walk through the maze and look at a few locations, you won't have any fun with this game.

Many thanks & best regards
Ben & Fabian
